title: Deck the Halls
_about: Welsh tune 'Nos Galan', checked note for note against an ABC transcription in C (folktunefinder.com tune 11542). SIMPLIFIED: the third line ('See the blazing Yule before us, fa la la...') has one F-sharp, which the 15 bells do not include; it is played as a plain F (Fa2). Add an F-sharp bell later to restore it. Melody in the upper octave (real recordings); it uses nine notes, so there is no 2-phone version. Bass on the lower octave, one note a bar, written for this arrangement. One beat = a quarter note.

parts.bass: Do/4 | Do/4 | Sol/4 | Do/4 | Do/4 | Do/4 | Sol/4 | Do/4 | Sol/4 | Do/4 | Re/4 | Sol/4 | Do/4 | Do/4 | Fa/4 | Do/4

_arrangements: Layouts proposed by a search that keeps every phone from ringing two notes at once and spreads quick notes between players. 1 and 2 phones play the melody only; 3 and 4 phones add the bass where it fits. Notes listed in 'alternate' sit on two phones and take turns. Spare gestures hold notes this song never uses, so a stray swing stays harmless. Sizes offered: 3, 4.
